purpose: Reverse Strategy Discovery & Alpha Attribution: explain why the five existing signal rules show no secured excess over SPY, describe what was publicly knowable before exceptional winners, and test new transparent rules on time-separated data. Not a search for a winner; negative results are valid results.

population.frameRule: V10 study frame rule (scripts/quant/v10/studies/common.cjs buildFrame): modal ISO-week labels, primary exchanges XNAS/XNYS/XASE
population.excluded: identityEvidenceProtocolV10 (owner release pending) is not used in primary results; may only appear as a labelled sensitivity
population.survivorship: Provider universe of today plus 150 ended series (28 sourced delistings, 122 censored frozen tails). Coverage vs SEC 10-K filers 2000 14 %, 2010 22 %, 2020 48 %. Every result reports this gap.

periods.dateMeaning: Periods refer to decision/signal dates; outcomes may mature after the period end. TRAIN decisions whose holding window reaches into VALIDATION are allowed and disclosed (overlap); VALIDATION and TEST results additionally report their first year separately.
periods.pitFundamentals: PIT SEC panel of the V10 factor strand (filed < decision date), available from 2010; anything fundamental before 2011 is excluded

rules: R1 Candidate rules are designed, tuned and selected using TRAIN decisions only.
R2 The candidate set (max 12 per family) is frozen in a committed file BEFORE any VALIDATION outcome of it is computed; VALIDATION is evaluated once per frozen set, Holm within the set.
R3 At most 3 final hypotheses are frozen in a committed file BEFORE the TEST period is computed; TEST is computed once and reported unconditionally.
R4 The descriptive WINNERS and DECOMPOSITION strands may use the full period; their outputs are firewalled: the DISCOVERY strand must not read them (enforced by instruction, documented).
R5 ORACLE (future knowledge) results are labelled ORACLE_LOOKAHEAD, serve only as an upper bound and for attribution, and never as a strategy or candidate source beyond TRAIN.

R6 Every return comparison states for strategy and benchmark: dates, return definition (price / total), costs, weighting, investment assumption (fully invested, cash), and whether the excess is observed or statistically secured (block bootstrap / Newey-West, multiple testing).
priorExposure: All periods 2000-2025 were explored by V7-V10 for the five signal rules, 15 price patterns, the reconstructed factor rank IC (2010-2025) and setups. VALIDATION and TEST are therefore time-separated, not untouched; a TEST success is not confirmatory forward evidence. The only untouched evidence remains future data (e.g. the prospective 8-K cohort from 2027-04-29).
benchmarks: SPY total return where a sourced dividend path exists (else stated as unavailable)
equal-weight frame population (same dates, same costs basis)
cap-weighted frame population from PIT market cap (2010+)
returnBasis: PRICE_RETURN for stocks (total return only for the 8 titles of the V10 TR register); every comparison with SPY uses the same basis on both sides
